title: Elytra HUD: Revived
description: A subtle Elytra durability indicator on the hot bar.
body:
Revival of [Elytra HUD by Apollo_2040](https://modrinth.com/mod/elytra-hud-mod)

Bringing this clean HUD indicator of your Elytra's durability to 26.1.x!

Adds a subtle indication of your elytra's current durability to the hotbar.
![Durability as a percentage](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9957bccde5eb16ec0866e3e35ce1209d5a696b14.jpeg)

Also configurable via [Mod Menu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu)
